source_time_text: Forex Factory: 1 hr 50 min ago at observation around 01:29 UTC; official RBA podcast released 05:00 AEST / 19:00 UTC, recorded Sep 7

evidence.dominant_driver: RBA Assistant Governor Sarah Hunter says upside inflation risks could require another hike, but the podcast was recorded on Sep 7 and markets now price about a 95% chance of a Sep 29 hike, making this mainly confirmation.

market_expectations.expected_value: ~95% probability of 25bp hike to 4.60% on Sep 29; peak around 4.85% early 2027
market_expectations.distribution_notes: Hawkish RBA path is already heavily priced.

absorption.reason: The content was recorded Sep 7 and repeats the existing hawkish RBA message. After publication, AUS200 was about +0.1% near 8738, so no clean bearish residual reaction appeared.

observations.VIX: low/risk-on into US close; exact fresh value unavailable
observations.interpretation: RBA hawkishness is confirmed by rate pricing, but cheaper oil, strong US equities and a non-negative AUS200 reaction oppose a fresh equity short.

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast from 01:44 UTC. Learning profile M2 mixed_neutral confidence 1-4 is ACTIONABLE/BOOST_CONFIDENCE at 15m and 1h; therefore no forced directional call against the observed absorption.

regimes.energy: oil sharply lower from recent highs

immediate.rationale: The hawkish message is old in substance and the ASX 200 is modestly higher after publication, so no fresh downside impulse is confirmed.

next_session.rationale: The RBA message reinforces an already priced hike rather than creating a new policy shock; Bullock's later remarks are the next catalyst.

15m.rationale: The hawkish message is old in substance and the ASX 200 is modestly higher after publication, so no fresh downside impulse is confirmed.

1h.rationale: A 95% priced September hike leaves little surprise; lower oil and strong global risk appetite offset the rates headwind.

4h.rationale: The index is near flat-to-positive while financials and healthcare offset rate-sensitive tech; the signal is being absorbed.

next_session.rationale: The RBA message reinforces an already priced hike rather than creating a new policy shock; Bullock's later remarks are the next catalyst.

predictions.mechanism: Higher expected RBA rates pressure valuations and rate-sensitive sectors, but lower oil reduces inflation pressure and global risk-on supports the index.
predictions.invalidation: A fresh rise in Australian front-end yields plus AUD strength and a break below the opening range would shift the residual view bearish; a dovish Bullock shift would support upside.
predictions.counter_case: The hike is already almost fully priced, oil is falling, and strong global equities can dominate the stale hawkish message and lift AUS200.
